CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

5. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

10. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

12. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   C. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Football.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
